## Why This Is Asked

This question probes runtime policy governance for CNFs, not just image provenance. It tests knowledge of per-tenant isolation, signed policy artifacts, admission controls, and safe rollback when drift is detected. It also covers how to validate changes with minimal manifests before broader rollout.

## Key Concepts

- OPA Gatekeeper
- Cosign signing
- KMS-backed policy store
- Drift detection and rollback
- Minimal in-namespace manifests

```rego
package kubernetes.admission

deny[{"msg": msg}] {
  input.request.kind.kind == "CNFConfig"
  not input.policySigned
  msg := "CNFConfig must be signed by tenant policy"
}
```

- How would you test drift detection?
- How would you roll back unsigned or mismatched updates?

## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- Telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry, Fluent Bit) across logs and traces
- Tenant context propagation and isolation
- PII masking via in-line filters (e.g., Lua) before forwarding
- Loki/Jaeger exporters and per-tenant pipelines

## Code Example
```yaml
# Fluent Bit ConfigMap snippet (Lua filter used for masking)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fluent-bit-pp
data:
  lua-filter.lua: |
    function filter(tag, dt)
      if dt["message"] ~= nil then
        dt["message"] = (dt["message"]):gsub("%w+@%w+%.%w+", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
      end
      return dt
    end
```
```yaml
# OTEL collector snippet (simplified)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: otel-collector-config
data:
  collector.yaml: |-
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc: {}
          http: {}
    processors:
      attributes:
        actions: [insert]
        keys: [tenant_id]
        from_context: true
    exporters:
      jaeger: {}
      loki: {}
    service:
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [attributes]
          exporters: [jaeger]

          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [attributes]

```

Why This Is Asked

- Validates runtime enforcement by per-tenant sidecars in a multi-cluster CNF gateway mesh

Key Concepts
- CustomResourceDefinition for TenantPolicy
- Cross-cluster replication with mTLS and SPIFFE IDs

- Conflict resolution and eventual consistency

Code Example
```yaml
# CRD: TenantPolicy
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: tenantpolicies.example.com
spec:
  group: example.com
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              tenantID:
                type: string
              namespaces:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              rules:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    action:
                      type: string
                      enum: [allow, deny]
                    resources:
                      type: array
                      items:
                        type: string
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: tenantpolicies
    singular: tenantpolicy
    kind: TenantPolicy
```

```yaml
# Policy Agent Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: policy-agent
  namespace: cnf-system
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: policy-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: policy-agent
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: agent
        image: policy-agent:latest
        env:
        - name: REMOTE_CLUSTER
          value: "peer-cluster.example.com"
        - name: SPIFFE_TRUST_DOMAIN
          value: "example.com"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: spiffe-bundle
          mountPath: /run/spiffe
      volumes:
      - name: spiffe-bundle
        configMap:
          name: spiffe-bundle
```

```yaml
---

spec:
  tenantID: tenant-a
  namespaces:
  - tenant-a
  rules:
  - action: allow
    resources:
    - service-a
    - service-b
```

```yaml
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: cnfnamespacesecurity
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: CNFNamespaceSecurityConstraint
        listKind: CNFNamespaceSecurityConstraintList
        plural: cnfnamespacesecurityconstraints
        singular: cnfnamespacesecurityconstraint
  targets:
  - target: admissionreviews
    rego: |
      package cnfnamespacesecurity
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.kind.kind == "Pod"
        some i
        input.review.object.spec.containers[i].securityContext.hostNetwork
        msg := "hostNetwork is forbidden for CNFs"
      }
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.kind.kind == "Pod"
        not input.review.object.spec.containers
        # fallback for non-pods
      }
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        some i
        input.review.object.spec.containers[i].securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem != true
        msg := "readOnlyRootFilesystem is required for all containers"
      }
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.object.spec.containers[i].securityContext.privileged == true
        msg := "privileged containers are disallowed"
      }
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates advanced telemetry architecture, per-tenant observability, dynamic sampling strategies, and operational safety practices for CNF gateways at scale.

## Key Concepts
- OpenTelemetry, OTLP, trace context propagation, and baggage
- Namespace-scoped configuration and feature flags
- Adaptive sampling policies with latency-aware thresholds
- Canary rollouts and rollback safety

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf.trace
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  cnf.trace.enabled: "true"
  cnf.trace.sample-rate: "0.25"
  cnf.trace.target: "otel-collector.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local:4317"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cnf-gateway
        image: cnf-gateway:latest
        env:
        - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: cnf.trace
              key: cnf.trace.target
      - name: otel-collector
        image: otel/collector:latest
        args: ["--config=/etc/otel/config.yaml"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: otel-config
          mountPath: /etc/otel
      volumes:
      - name: otel-config
        configMap:
          name: otel-collector-config
```

## Adaptive Sampling Implementation
```go
func AdaptiveSampler(sampleRate float64, errorRate float64) float64 {
    baseRate := sampleRate
    if errorRate > 0.05 {
        return min(1.0, baseRate*2)
    }
    return baseRate
}
```

## Rollout Strategy
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 5
      - pause: {duration: 5m}
      analysis:
        templates:
        - templateName: error-rate-check
        successfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
        failedRunHistoryLimit: 3
```
